name: Plague Aspect
description: Attacks [dark-red]plague[/dark-red] enemies for [effect:second][dark-gray]4-8 seconds[/dark-gray][/effect], stacking [effect:time][dark-gray]1-3 times[/dark-gray][/effect]. [dark-red]Plagued[/dark-red] enemies have [effect:wither][dark-gray]Wither I-III[/dark-gray][/effect] and spread a [dark-red]plague[/dark-red] stack to the nearest [effect:enemies][dark-gray]1-3 enemies[/dark-gray][/effect] within 8 blocks on death.

effects.explanation:
Level I: 4 seconds
Level II: 6 seconds
Level III: 8 seconds

Level I: 1 time
Level II: 2 times
Level III: 3 times
Number of spreads equals Plague stacks.
